created_prompt:
Create a solid three-year plan for Julie to grow online and publish a cookbook.
Julie currently posts cooking videos online, focusing on quick, healthy recipes. Julie currently has 1.2M followers.
Julie would like to publish a cookbook - should she go for the traditional publishing route or should she consider self-publishing? Give the pros and cons and make an appropriate decision on which would be best for Julie.
Julie currently works four days a week, with limited time and budget, so please take this into consideration when devising the three-year plan.
